title: Nearly Simple Syrup

items.description: part sugar (284 grams, instead of the traditional 1:1 ratio)

steps: Have a large non-reactive bowl and a large mason jar ready.
Measure out the sugar, 284 grams (0.6 parts).
Measure out the hot water from an electric kettle or other source, 460 grams (1 part), in the large non-reactive bowl.
Add the sugar to the hot water and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Pour into mason jar and seal, store in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.
